_README: PBE string-transformation battery -- SynthEnumerate called DIRECTLY (no MBPP pipeline, no NL prompt anywhere) on a genuinely new, hand-built 26-task corpus. Two arms at DEFAULT_BUDGET (max_size=15, max_candidates=200000): typed_default (ops=None/consts=None, the engine's own typed default, zero caller hints) and declared (a single FIXED op/const inventory, PBE_OPS/PBE_CONSTS, applied uniformly to every task). Every declared-arm failure is re-probed once at HIGH_BUDGET (max_size=20, max_candidates=2000000, the CEILING_REASSESSMENT_7 probe budget).
